outcome: Duration of the third stage of labor
cohort: A total of 200 women undergoing either normal vaginal delivery (NVD) or lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) were enrolled and divided equally into two groups receiving carbetocin or oxytocin.
finding: Carbetocin was more effective than oxytocin in achieving faster placental separation, reducing third-stage labor duration, minimizing blood loss, and lowering the risk of atonic PPH.
mod_finding: The benefits of carbetocin, including reduced PPH risk, were observed in both normal vaginal and operative (cesarean) deliveries.
